senses.gloss:
--a son of प्रतीप and a brother of देवापी; was a great king learned and a specialist in medicine (महा- भिषक्); it is said that a touch of his hand cured people of any disease and made them youthful again; hence his name शम्तनु; married जाह्नवी; father of Devavrata (भीष्म); from the dark fisherwoman he got विचित्रवीर्य. Another son was चित्रान्गद; a Paurava with an अम्श of [page३-381+ २७] Samudra.
1: भा. IX. २२. १२-21; XII. 2. ३७; Br. III. १०. ६९, ७०; M. १४, १७; ५०. ११, ३९. ४५; वा. ७३. १८; ९९. २३४, २३७-41; १११. ७०; Vi. IV. २०. 9. ३४.
Came upon the twins of सत्यधृति, in the course of a hunting, कृप and कृपि and took them by grace; greed for more territory.
2: भा. IX. २१. ३६; XII. 3. १०; वा. 1. १५८; ९९. २०४; Vi. IV. १९. ६७-8.
--rescued the Gautamas, twin children of सत्यधृति. M. ५०. ११. [page३-528+ २८]
(I)--a son of धर्मसूत्र and father of Dyumat- sena. भा. IX. २२. ४८.

(III)--a son of आयु. Br. III. 3. २४.

(VI)--a son of आप. वा. ६६. २३.

(II)--a son of शूर and Bhoja, and father of four sons; became a राजऋषि. Br. III. ७१. १५०, १९४; M. ४६. 3, २७, २८.

(IV)--a companion of Kamsa; walked away with child Pradyumna within ten days [six days (वि। प्।)] of its birth. He knew that the bady was his enemy but he threw it into the sea and went away. मायावती, the super- intendent of his kitchen discovered a child in a fish brought to the kitchen, and hearing from नारद that it was काम reborn, and that she herself was रती, she brought up the child and when he came of age, she told him the truth and asked him to fight शम्बर with the aid of महामाया vidya1. His head was cut off by Pradyumna. भा. X. ३६. ३६; ५५. 3. २४; II. 7. ३४; III. 3. ११; Vi. V. २६. १२; Ch. २७ (whole).
(V)--(शबर-भा। प्।); his greed for more territory. भा. XII. 3. ११.
--(शम्बल-भा। प्।); the birth place of Kalki-विष्णु. भा. XII. 2. १८; Vi. IV. २४. ९८. [page३-386+ २६]
(I)--the Indra of the epoch of the Tenth Manu, and a friend of विष्वक्सेन. भा. VIII. १३. २२-23.
(II)--a son of अम्बरीष. भा. IX. 6. 1.
(IV)--father of राजाज and Goma. Br. III. 5. ४०.

(VI)--one of the eleven Rudras;
1: M. १५३. १९; १७१. ३८; Vi. I. १५. १२२.
had the Ganga in his plaited hair for more than १०० years.
2: Ib. II. 8. ११५; V. ३२. ११; ३३. 4.
(VII)--a son of Virocana; had six sons. वा. ६७. ७६, ८१.
(VIII)--a son of Bhavya. Vi. I. १३. 1.
--a son of शुक. वा. ७०. ८५.
--the hermitage of व्यास on the bank of the सरस्वती. भा. I. 7. 2-3.
--a son of बृहस्पति; asked his father as to the pros and cons of the श्राद्ध. Br. III. 9. ३८-44; वा. ७१. ३७. [page३-387+ २४]
--a ऋषिक who became a sage by satya. Br. II. ३२. १०२.
--one of the two sons of गार्हपत्य; also आह- वनीय and हव्यवाहन; father of two sons, Savya and Apasavya; married the १६ rivers for his wives; their sons were धिष्णिस्. Br. II. १२. १२; वा. २९. ११-12.
--the place of Havya agni. Br. II. १२. २३; वा. २९. २२.

--the act of killing the sacrificial victim and making it ready for offering;
1: वा. 2. 6.
performed by मृत्यु in the विश्वशृज् sacrifice.
2: Br. I. 2. 6.
--have to their credit ८६०८ R2ks. वा. ६१. ६१, ६२.
--a son of Alarka, and father of सुनीथ. भा. IX. १७. 8.

(I)--(see सन्नती); a daughter of दक्ष and wife of Kratu;
1: Br. II. 9. ५६; वा. २८. ३१; Vi. I. 7. २५.

(II)--a son of Kaikaya and श्रुतकीर्ती. Br. III. ७१. १५७; वा. ९६. १५६; Vi. IV. १४. ४२.

--appellation महाप्राञ्ज्ञ (very wise); honoured for story-telling. वा. १०३. 6.

(I)--see Mitrasaha. Vi. IV. 4. ४५.
(II)--a son of सुदास and father of Saha- deva. Vi. IV. १९. ७१.
--a son of अण्डिर. M. ४८. 4.
(I)--a diplomatic means; alliance with enemies should be sought to gain one's object, even as the serpent with rat. भा. VIII. 6. २०.
(II)--a son of प्रसुश्रुत, and father of Amar- षण. भा. IX. १२. 7.

(I)--unfit for the procreative act. At this time शिव is said to move with his गणस् to different places; personified as woman; approached by Asuras lavishing praises on her;

The time between उषा and व्युष्टि; the time for worship by means of गायत्री to relieve the sun from being attacked by Mandeha राक्षसस्,
2: Br. II. २१. १०८-13; २२. ११; वा. ३०. १५; ५०. १६२; ५१. ११.

--a Marut of the 6th गण. Br. III. 5-९७.

--a son of Atri, the अवतार् of the १२थ् dva1para. वा. २३. १५७.

(II)--a son of क्रिया. वा. १०. ३५.

--a son of क्षेमाधि, and father of Satya- ratha. भा. IX. १३. २४.

--one of the twenty of अमिताभ gan2a. वा. १००. १६.

--a son of बुहुगवी. वा. ९९. १२२.

--a science which enables one to bring the dead back to life; known to शुक्राचार्य and not known to बृहस्पति; learnt as a disciple from शुक्र by Kaca son of बृहस्पति; revived Kaca done to death twice by the Asuras. M. २५. १३, ३६, ५४, ६५: २७. १९: २४९. 4.
--a son of कूति; father of महिष्मत्. वा. ९४. 5.

(I)--daughter of विश्वकर्मन् (त्वष्ट्(r)a-म्। and ब्र्। प्।); consort of सूर्य (Vivasvat-भा। प्।) gave birth to Manu, Yama and यमी; unable to bear the effulgence of [page३-542+ २९] her husband, she engaged छाया, her servant maid, to take her place, and left for penance; to छाया were born शनैश्- cara, Manu (सावर्णि), तपती; finding fault with Yama once the Sun god discovered छाया's identity and after a search found सम्ज्ञा doing penance as a mare in the plains of Utta- rakuru;
1: भा. VIII. १३. 8-9: VI. 6. ४०: IX. 1. ११: M. ११. 2 and २४-37; वा 84. २१; १००. ३१.
he became a horse in turn and सम्ज्ञा as a mare gave birth to three more children; the two अश्विन्स् and Re- vanta; विश्वकर्म filed off the वैष्णव effulgence and out of this he crafted the discus of विष्णु, the trident of शिव, the पुष्पकविमान of Kubera the lance (शक्ति) of कार्तिकेय and others.
2: Br. II. २४. ९०: III. ५९. २२-3; IV. 1. २८: Vi. III. 2. 2-१२.
(II)--a शक्ति. Br. IV. ४४. ८७.
--a son of Kunti and father of महिष्मत्. Br. III. ६९. 5.
--a son of अरुण and गृध्रि; father of Vijaya and Prasaha. Br. III. 7. ४४७.
(I)--a son of सुप्रतीक elephant. Br. III. 7. ३४१.
(II)--a son of अरुण and श्येनि and father of Babhru and Sighraga; a fabulous bird and brother of जटायु. M. 6. ३५: वा. ६९. ३२७.
(III)--a son of Bahuvidha. M. ४९. 3.
--managed the elephant corps in the war with भण्ड. Br. IV. १६. 7-१३: २२. ३७.
--offered fight to Durmada. Br. IV. २२. ३६-66.
--see सम्पत्करी. Br. IV. २८. ३८. [page३-543+ २५]
--one of the seven important rays of the sun. Br. II. २४. ६६.
--in honour of लक्ष्मी. M. १०१. २०.
--a son of Samara. M. ४९. ५४.
--a Pravara. M. १९६. ३०.
--the enlightened like ऋभु and Sanat- कुमार. वा. १०१. २१२.
--a son of युवनाश्व and नर्मदा; father of अनरण्य. Br. III. ६३. ७३.
--an elephant daughter of dig-नागस्. Br. III. 7. ३५४. [page३-544+ २३]
--a daughter of जाम्बवती and कृष्ण. Br. III. ७१. २५०; वा. ९६. २४१.
--the goddess following रेवती. M. १७९. ७२.
(I)--a son of Sarva. M. ५०. ३१.
(II)--at the end of सम्हार; impossible to be told in detail; also nisarga. वा. ६१. १३६-7.
--a Janapada of the भद्रा continent. वा. ४३. २१.
--महेश्वर, father of creation. वा. १०३. ३७.
--a son of Raivata. Vi. III. 1. २३.
--a son of ट्रसदस्यु and father of Anaraya. वा. ८८. ७४-75.
--sons of Meru सावर्णि. वा. १००. ५९.
(I)--a wife of वैराज. भा. VIII. 5. 9. [page३-545+ २३]
(II)--a wife of Jayadratha. भा. IX. २३. १२.
(III)--a son of Vasuda. M. १२. ३६.
